retry-state.observableResult: Retry from empty/error/forbidden shows ready content

create-record.observableResult: Valid name creates visible row; blank name shows validation feedback

batch-update.observableResult: Confirm changes selected rows to 已处理; cancel preserves state

save-form.observableResult: Empty name shows failure; valid name shows save feedback

select-node.observableResult: Highlights node and shows selected id

zoom-topology.observableResult: Zoom changes scale; fit restores scale

advance-resolution.observableResult: Advances active resolution step, then resets
